column4: dialect-gated: this job (go test ./engine/... with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set) runs Postgres and skips MySQL and MSSQL -- cleat#1980's TestEntryPointSchemasRoundTrip and TestEntryPointSchemasNullWhenNotSupplied both iterate pluginDepsBackends() (postgres, mysql, mssql), so each test's mysql and mssql subtests skip here while postgres runs -- four, not six. Same registeredBackends shape as other cluster-job entries in this directory (see a-workflow-def-defaults-to-the-auth-exposure-class.tsv). Measured locally against a real Postgres container with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set: `go test ./engine/... ./migration/... -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' | grep -c 'EntryPointSchemas'` = 4, on all three repeated measurement attempts.

Pairing line for the cluster entry above, required by scripts/check-skip-ledger-engine-coverage.py (cleat#2158): engine-race.yml -- the only job that checks the test-go/engine key, 4-hourly off the per-PR trigger set -- runs with the same single-DSN (postgres-only) shape as the cluster job above, so both tests' mysql and mssql subtests skip there too. Identical regex to the cluster line, as the pairing check requires; not independently measured against a live engine-race.yml run (it is not a per-PR job), but the dialect gating is the same registeredBackends mechanism as the cluster line, which was measured.
